title.narrative: Support for the implementation of the Local Public Administration Reform in Moldova

description.narrative: The Republic of Moldova was granted candidate status for the European Union (EU) in June 2022 and started accession negotiations in June 2024. The Public Administration Reform Strategy (PARS), approved in 2023, outlines a clear path to advance the objectives related to EU integration- effective governance through capable central and local authorities, professional civil servants, transparent and modern processes - with a significant emphasis on local governance, dedicating an entire chapter to this topic. The purpose of this Initiation Plan is to provide support the Government of the Republic of Moldova (the State Chancellery, as well as the Ministry of Finance) in implementing the PARS 2023-2030, particularly Objective V: Local public administration. A key aspect of this effort is to support launching and implementing the voluntary amalgamation process, demonstrating better and more equitable service provision and sustainable local development in the amalgamated communities. Additionally, UNDP’s Local Public Administration Reform Advisory Team (LPAR Advisory Team) will develop a comprehensive project proposal for further PARS support. This will ensure continuous progress, adaptability to new challenges, and the strengthening of local public authorities capacity for sustainable development and EU integration. The LPAR Advisory Team will also assist with other related policies, such as fiscal decentralization, and conduct regular monitoring and evaluation of the LPAR implementation.
